Air.description:
AT4: the air (scope 6.3): the height and volumetric fog of the look and weather, the
light shafts (each light kind's share in the volumetric fog), the live sets and the
engine settings the controller runs with.

beam_fog_gain.description: A searchlight beam's glow grows by this times the fog's share (AT2's beams kept).
beam_fog_gain.title: Beam Fog Gain

cvars.description: Engine settings the controller applies while it runs (the budget's room, AT4).
cvars.title: Cvars

fog_hours.description: The fog's density by hour, a share of `fog_density` (mist forms after dusk).
fog_hours.title: Fog Hours

puffs.description: Cards per plume by emitter kind.
puffs.title: Puffs

scatter.description: Volumetric scattering by light kind (light shafts; 0 none).
scatter.title: Scatter

steam.description: cars_steam: the steam and smoke plumes shown at start (the spec's `steam`; off by default, issue #223).
steam.title: Steam

steam_far.description: AT6: the plumes' opacity times 1 + a from 30 m to b m off (they read far off).
steam_far.title: Steam Far

steam_glow.description: AT6: the plumes lit by the city by night (their emissive, of their albedo, times Night).
steam_glow.title: Steam Glow

volume_glow.description: The fog volumes' glow by night (their emissive's scale).
volume_glow.title: Volume Glow

Air.title: Air

Emitter.description:
AT4: a steam or smoke plume on its manhole, drain, vent, roof unit, stall or chimney
(the runtime draws it as rising cards, scope 4.2).

owner_id.description: What it rises from: an AG7 road piece, an M3 building, an M6 prop, an M9 vent.
owner_id.title: Owner Id

pos.description: Where it leaves its source (m, absolute z).
pos.title: Pos

rise_m.description: How high it rises before it fades.
rise_m.title: Rise M

source.description: assetgen: read from what stage 2 drew (AG7's manholes and drains); derived: from citygen (a fixture asked of stage 2 where it draws none: a chimney).
source.title: Source

width_m.description: The plume's width at its source.
width_m.title: Width M

Emitter.title: Emitter

Far.description:
AT7: the far city's cards (scope 6.6, `far.py`): their tiles, counts and the runtime's
settings.

fade.description: Cards fade in over this share of each live range, as the live lights fade out there.
fade.title: Fade

gain.description: The runtime's gain on every card (art direction).
gain.title: Gain

px.description: A glow's least width on screen (pixels).
px.title: Px

spread.description: A card's gaussian over its square: its peak luminance is its intensity over this times its size squared.
spread.title: Spread

Far.title: Far

FogVolume.description:
AT4: a fog or smog volume (mist over water, smog over industry, haze under decks and
in tunnels): an ellipsoid (Unreal's local fog volume), its half sizes along its yaw.

density.description: Extinction at its middle (1/m, along its long axis).
density.title: Density

extent.description: Half sizes (m) of its ellipsoid: along its yaw, across, up.
extent.title: Extent

floor.description: The share of it that is height fog, dense at its foot.
floor.title: Floor

glow.description: How much of the city's light it shows where no live light reaches it (its emissive, of its albedo).
glow.title: Glow

owner_id.description: Its water body, district, megasite, deck or tunnel.
owner_id.title: Owner Id

FogVolume.title: FogVolume

Glow.description:
AT3: the cloud deck's underside lit by the city (`sky.glow`): a raster of its
luminance, linear RGB, square-root encoded in an 8-bit PNG (row 0 the north edge).

max_nits.description: A channel's value at 255 (cd/m2, physical): the runtime squares the texel and scales by it.
max_nits.title: Max Nits

mean_nits.description: The mean over the city's extent (cd/m2).
mean_nits.title: Mean Nits

peak_at.description: Where the deck glows brightest (citygen m).
peak_at.title: Peak At

Glow.title: Glow

Mask.description:
AT5: a tile's mask (`masks/<tile>.png`, 0.5 m texels, row 0 the north edge, RGBA): red
the cover (the lowest underside over the texel of what shelters it, absolute: the plan's
`weather.cover` datum plus red times its step; 0 open sky), green the puddles (0 none to
255 the deepest), blue the drip band under a low cover's edge, alpha the surface's gloss
when wet.
Mask.title: Mask

Moon.description:
AT3: the moon (`sky.moon_at`): it trails the sun by `lag_h`, its declination mirrored
by its phase.

cloud.description: The share of its light the deck's cover takes.
cloud.title: Cloud

disk_nits.description: Its disk's luminance in the scene's frame (cd/m2 at the night's exposure).
disk_nits.title: Disk Nits

lag_h.description: How far it trails the sun (hours): 24 times the phase.
lag_h.title: Lag H

lit.description: Its lit fraction (its light scales by it).
lit.title: Lit

rise.description: Its light fades in between these elevations (degrees).
rise.title: Rise

share.description: A full moon's light as a share of the sun's (the look's).
share.title: Share

Moon.title: Moon

Post.description:
AT6: the look's post and grade (scope 6.5, `atmosgen/look.py`): the look's night and
day sets, each district's, the exposure, the district raster the runtime blends them by.

base.description: The look's sets: {night, day}, each its `keys` and `shadows_gain`, `highlights_gain` (rgb).
base.title: Base

blend_m.description: The runtime weighs the districts over a disc this wide round the view ...
blend_m.title: Blend M

districts.description: Each district's sets by id (its grit and tint over the look's).
districts.title: Districts

ease_s.description: ... and eases to them over this (s).
ease_s.title: Ease S

exposure.description: The night's and the day's exposure (EV100), the day's bias and the overcast's compensation.
exposure.title: Exposure

keys.description: The scalar keys of a set (`presets.POST_KEYS`).
keys.title: Keys

order.description: The districts in the raster's index order.
order.title: Order

raster.description: `post_districts.png`: each cell's district (an index into `order`), rows from the north edge, its bounds, cell, size and sha256.
raster.title: Raster

Post.title: Post

Sight.description:
What a walker sees: the occluders the runtime marches a line of sight through
(`sight.py`: the lux check's, on `cell_m` cells, every rounding toward seeing).

file.description: `sight.png` beside the plan, row 0 the north edge: red the top (absolute, `top_step_m` steps, 0 none), green the bottom over the ground (`bottom_step_m` steps, 0 on the ground), blue the ground (`ground_step_m` steps).
file.title: File

occupied.description: The share of the cells something stands in.
occupied.title: Occupied

skip_eye_m.description: The march leaves out this much from the eye ...
skip_eye_m.title: Skip Eye M

skip_light_m.description: ... and this much to the light.
skip_light_m.title: Skip Light M

Sight.title: Sight

Sky.description: AT3: the sky and the time of day (scope 6.2, `sky.make`).

cloud_cover.description: The share of the sky the deck hides.
cloud_cover.title: Cloud Cover

cloud_glow.description: A gain on the city's light the deck shows.
cloud_glow.title: Cloud Glow

curve.description: Curves over the sun's elevation (`elev`): ev (night 0 to day 1), night, sun, sky, stars (`presets.SUN_CURVE`).
curve.title: Curve

ev_day.description: The day's exposure (EV100), darker under a closed deck.
ev_day.title: Ev Day

ev_night.description: The night's exposure in the scene's frame (EV100), held: the plan's lights are shown at 2^(ev_night - night_ev100) at every hour.
ev_night.title: Ev Night

hours.description: The named hours: day, dusk (the sun at `presets.SKY` dusk elevation), night.
hours.title: Hours

stars.description: How many stars the clear dark sky shows (0 to 1).
stars.title: Stars

sun_lux.description: The sun's light by day in the scene's frame (lux; the importer's sun).
sun_lux.title: Sun Lux

upward_lm.description: The plan's upward luminous flux (lm) at the glow's hour, the deck's glow.
upward_lm.title: Upward Lm

Sky.title: Sky

SkyHour.description: AT3: a row of the plan's day (the report; the runtime computes any hour itself).
SkyHour.title: SkyHour

high_max.description: ... and how many of its lights live at most.
high_max.title: High Max

sight_m.description: Visible lights: round a walker the runtime keeps live the lights it sees (a line of sight through the plan's `sight` raster) within this (m) ...
sight_m.title: Sight M

sight_max.description: ... at most this many (the high tier's pool keeps `high_max`).
sight_max.title: Sight Max

sha256.description: sha256 of the tile file's bytes.
sha256.title: Sha256

Weather.description:
AT5: the weather (scope 6.4, `weather.py`): the states, the rain's age, the wind, the
masks' frame and the drips.

cover.description: The cover channel's datum (z0_m) and step (step_m).
cover.title: Cover

extent.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1]: the masks' tiles.
extent.title: Extent

gloss.description: The gloss when wet by surface class.
gloss.title: Gloss

live.description: What the runtime keeps near the view.
live.title: Live

times.description: transition_s (a state change), wet_s and dry_s (the open surfaces), fill_s and drain_s (the puddles): the runtime's seconds.
times.title: Times

wind.description: heading_deg (counterclockwise from east, the way it blows), lean (the rain's drift over its fall), shift_max_m, cover_max_m, gale_m_s (MPC_CityGen's Wind 1).
wind.title: Wind

Weather.title: Weather

WeatherState.description: AT5: one weather state as the runtime blends to it.

drops.description: The share of the rain cards that fall.
drops.title: Drops

gust.description: The wind's gusts, a share of its speed.
gust.title: Gust

puddles.description: How full the puddles get (a share of their depth).
puddles.title: Puddles

streak.description: A streak's length, a share of the rain's (drizzle's short).
streak.title: Streak

volumes.description: A gain on the fog volumes (mist, smog).
volumes.title: Volumes

wetness.description: How wet the open surfaces get.
wetness.title: Wetness

WeatherState.title: WeatherState

air.description: AT4: the fog, light shafts and live sets.

checks.description: AT1: the lux check's result (`lux.check`): `ok` and per walkway class its points, average, share under the minimum and targets. The exporter imports a plan only when it passed (scope 8: not delivered otherwise).
checks.title: Checks

districts.description: Every district's resolved mood by id.
districts.title: Districts

far.description: AT7: the far city's light cards past the live set.

night_ev100.description: The exposure the lights are set for; a scene shown at another scales them by 2^(EV_scene - night_ev100).
night_ev100.title: Night Ev100

post.description: AT6: the look's post and grade, per district.

sight.description: Visible lights: the sight raster the runtime picks a walker's lights by.

sources.description: Lights by source: derived or assetgen (the asks met).
sources.title: Sources

weather_plan.description: AT5: the weather states, the rain's age, the wind, the masks' frame, the drips.
